name: Vaniar
source:
Vaniar is an adult visual novel created with Ren'py , based on a vampire universe with components of horror, romance and mystery.

The protagonist, an ordinary man, suffers the most devastating loss imaginable: the mysterious disappearance of his wife and daughter—without warning, without a trace, as if they had vanished from the world.

Consumed by despair and rage, he embarks on a solitary quest that drags him into the shadows. He is no longer the same. Pain changes him. He trains, hardens... and becomes a warrior. The only one capable of facing the impossible.

Dark forces try to stop him. They fail.

Years later, he finally finds a clue.

Will he follow it?

How far will he go to bring them back?

That... depends on you.
translation:
《Vaniar》是由Ren'py创作的成人视觉小说，以吸血鬼宇宙为背景，包含恐怖、浪漫和神秘元素。

主角，一个普通的男人，遭受了可以想象到的最具毁灭性的损失：他的妻子和女儿神秘失踪——没有任何警告，没有任何痕迹，就好像他们从世界上消失了一样。

绝望和愤怒吞噬了他，他开始了一项孤独的探索，却将自己拖入了阴影。他不再是原来的他了。痛苦改变了他。他训练、磨练……并成为一名战士。唯一有能力面对不可能的事情的人。

黑暗势力试图阻止他。他们失败了。

多年后，他终于找到了线索。

他会跟随吗？

他要走多远才能把他们带回来？

这……取决于你。
